section_summary.extract_value: This section details the sample and procedure for a study involving 465 older adults (294 women) from Ekiti State, Nigeria. The mean age of participants was 74.18 years (SD = 9.42). A multistage sampling technique was used to recruit participants from 14 community settings across three senatorial districts, achieving a 97% response rate.
